label: Commercial facilities (retail, lodging, casino)
description: Places people shop, stay and gamble: enclosed and open-air malls with their tenants, big-box, grocery and department-store chains, hotels and resorts, commercial and tribal casinos and integrated resorts, and mixed-use towers run by property managers, with their corporate security and loss-prevention operations. Point-of-sale and payment systems, property management and keycards, casino management and slot systems, surveillance rooms, and the regulators, card brands and tenants that go with them. Stadiums, arenas and outdoor events belong to the stadium/venue domain.

vocabulary.facility: the property (stores and tenant spaces, hotel towers, the casino floor, entrances, garages and back-of-house)
vocabulary.public: shoppers, hotel guests and casino patrons
vocabulary.frontline: security officers, loss-prevention agents, front-desk agents, cashiers, casino cage and surveillance staff, housekeepers, engineering technicians
vocabulary.operationsCenter: the security command center / surveillance room

it: point-of-sale (Oracle Xstore/MICROS, NCR, Toshiba) and payment terminals with processor links (PCI scope)
e-commerce, loyalty program and gift-card systems
hotel property management system (Oracle OPERA, Infor HMS), central reservations and channel managers
keycard / door-lock system (ASSA ABLOY Vostio, dormakaba)
casino management system: slot accounting and player tracking (IGT Advantage, Konami SYNKROS, Aristocrat Oasis)
cage and count systems, ticket-in/ticket-out kiosks and the sportsbook platform
ot: CCTV / VMS and the surveillance room (regulator-mandated retention in casinos)
fire alarm, mass notification and PA
parking garage gates and license-plate readers
slot machines on the slot data network

roles.name: General Manager / Property GM (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Decides property closure, lockdown or evacuation, guest relocation, and coordination with tenants or the brand.

roles.name: Director of Security / Asset Protection
roles.description: Owns security officers, CCTV, access control, the police liaison, active-assailant response and trespass.

roles.name: Chief Information Security Officer (Technical Lead)
roles.description: Owns containment, the IR firm, the FBI/CISA liaison, the PCI forensic investigator and any regulator cyber notice; works with IT on restoring POS, PMS and the casino management system.

roles.name: Director of Communications (PIO)
roles.description: Owns media, social, guest and customer statements, and coordination with the franchisor or tenants.

roles.name: Corporate Crisis Management Team Lead / Chief Operating Officer
roles.description: Owns enterprise decisions across properties, ransom and disclosure with counsel, and brand or franchisor obligations.

roles.name: Compliance Officer / BSA-AML Officer
roles.description: Owns gaming-regulator notifications, FinCEN SAR and CTR decisions and the regulator liaison.

roles.name: Director of Loss Prevention
roles.description: Owns theft and fraud investigations, the organized retail crime task-force liaison, evidence and gift-card fraud.

roles.name: Director of Engineering / Facilities
roles.description: Owns fire and life-safety systems, power, HVAC, elevators, garages and the generator.

outsideParties: police and fire, and county emergency management
the FBI field office and CISA (Protective Security Advisors, Commercial Facilities sector team)
the U.S. Secret Service (payment-card fraud, Cyber Fraud Task Force)
HSI and the state organized retail crime task force
the state gaming control board or commission and the tribal gaming commission
FinCEN (casino SARs) and the state attorney general (breach)
the health department and the fire marshal
RH-ISAC and the Real Estate ISAC
the payment processor, acquiring bank and card brands, and a PCI forensic investigator
POS, PMS and casino management system vendors
the franchisor or brand, mall tenants and anchor stores
the contract security company, the cyber insurer and the DFIR firm
mediaChannels: guest videos on X/Twitter, TikTok and Instagram
TripAdvisor and Google reviews from frustrated guests
the local TV assignment desk with a live shot from the parking lot
national business press for a chain or casino operator

sceneAnchors.public: inside a two-level enclosed shopping mall on a busy Saturday: shoppers with bags walking past store fronts, a food court with tables, escalators, a glass skylight, bright daylight from above
sceneAnchors.control: inside a casino surveillance room: an operator at a desk with joystick camera controllers and dark monitors, radios, a binder of procedures, dim light
sceneAnchors.exterior: a resort hotel and casino entrance: a covered porte-cochere with valet stands and luggage carts, a high-rise hotel tower behind, palm trees, a parking garage to the side, late-afternoon light

an escalator stopped for a maintenance call
a guest locked out after a keycard demagnetized

a review site flooded with complaints about rooms that will not open
a reporter asking whether card data was stolen
